behavior.bridgeDesc: Lets the external order-processing harness (LangGraph) drive this browser. Listens only on 127.0.0.1. While the bridge is on, any harness holding the token acts with full permission regardless of the permission mode setting — no confirmation cards; clicks, typing, login, and payment-password entry happen unattended. Read-only mode blocks the bridge
behavior.bridgeHint: Put SAMBA_BRIDGE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port> and SAMBA_BRIDGE_TOKEN=<token> in the harness .env. While the bridge is using tools, the chat AI is unavailable
